**MSci Physics with Theoretical Physics, First Class**  
University of Nottingham

Theoretical physicist interested in quantum gravity, holography, quantum field theory, geometry, and mathematical physics.

I am currently seeking funded PhD opportunities for 2027/28 in mathematical physics, quantum gravity, holography, and related areas.

## Research

My research focuses on how time, geometry, and observables are encoded in gravitational theories, working in settings rigid enough that questions can be settled by calculation rather than argument: three-dimensional AdS gravity, conformal infinity, and operator-algebraic models of emergent geometry.

Three questions organise my work. **What is a clock?** In AdS$_3$ gravity on a closed surface, every constant-mean-curvature time defines its own Hamiltonian on the same phase space. I show these are a single function read at different momentum scales, and ask what this implies for the boundary stress tensor. **How far can holography be iterated?** Conformal infinity fixes only a conformal class, which blocks a naive recursive dictionary and points toward relative or defect sectors. **Can geometry be reconstructed from algebraic data?** My MSci project builds geometry, gauge structure, and gravity from von Neumann algebras and modular flow on weighted graphs.
